description: This file contains utility functions related to string manipulations, including encoding/decoding, splitting, joining, pattern replacements, and special character handling within the StringUtil class.

classes.name: StringWrapper
classes.description: A lightweight wrapper for String objects, primarily used in templates to bypass HTML auto-encoding.

methods.name: replaceString
methods.description: Replaces all occurrences of a specified old string with a new string in the main string.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Concatenates elements of a collection into a single string separated by a delimiter.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a string based on a delimiter into a list of substrings.

methods.name: splitWithStringSeparator
methods.description: Splits a string based on a specified string separator into a list.

methods.name: strToMap
methods.description: Converts a delimited string into a map of key-value pairs, supporting URL decoding.

methods.name: mapToStr
methods.description: Encodes a map into a string with key-value pairs joined by '=' and pairs separated by '|'.

methods.name: toList
methods.description: Converts a string representation of a list into an actual List object.

methods.name: toSet
methods.description: Converts a string representation of a set into an actual Set object.

methods.name: createMap
methods.description: Creates a map from parallel lists of keys and values.

methods.name: cleanUpPathPrefix
methods.description: Normalizes a path prefix string to start with '/' and not end with '/'. Replaces backslashes with forward slashes.

methods.name: removeSpaces
methods.description: Removes all spaces from a string.

methods.name: toHexString
methods.description: Converts a byte array into a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: cleanHexString
methods.description: Removes spaces and colons from a hex string.

methods.name: fromHexString
methods.description: Decodes a hex string into a byte array.

methods.name: encodeInt
methods.description: Encodes an integer into hex characters, used in SHA-like digest calculations.

methods.name: removeNonNumeric
methods.description: Removes all non-digit characters from the string.

methods.name: removeRegex
methods.description: Removes all substrings matching a regex pattern.

methods.name: addToNumberString
methods.description: Adds a long number to the numeric value of a string, with zero-padding.

methods.name: padNumberString
methods.description: Pads a number string with leading zeros to reach a minimum length.

methods.name: convertOperatorSubstitutions
methods.description: Converts special operator placeholders like @and, @or back to their symbolic operators.

methods.name: truncateEncodedStringToLength
methods.description: Truncates a string to a specified length, considering special encoded characters and inserting ellipsis.

methods.name: getTruncateStartLimit
methods.description: Calculates the starting index for truncation, ensuring special characters are not cut.

methods.name: getTruncateEndLimit
methods.description: Calculates the ending index for truncation, ensuring special characters are not cut.

methods.name: wrapString
methods.description: Wraps a string into a StringWrapper object.

methods.name: makeStringWrapper
methods.description: Creates a StringWrapper object from a string, with special handling if the string is empty.
